# Report a vulnerability privately

For bounty eligibility, submit by email to <security@sidioralabs.com> only, with a full and clear report (including an end-to-end reproduction and every item listed in SECURITY.md) and credentials demonstrating that you are legitimate and competent. Examples of credentials include prior published disclosures or CVE credits, a professional or audit-firm affiliation, a verifiable identity, and an account of how the issue was found. A report missing email-only submission, the full report or credentials is handled as an ordinary report with no reward. See [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for the bounty policy.

GitHub's private vulnerability reporting flow remains available from the repository Security tab. Anything submitted through GitHub, including private vulnerability reporting, or another public surface (issue, discussion, pull request, advisory or social post) is fixed through the normal maintenance process without attribution or reward. Do not disclose suspected vulnerabilities publicly.
